updated_for: 2026-09-06 role-split ticket guard: third-line coverage, hidden-fixed-partner prevention, and honest hedged display

repeatability_learning.rule: Initial winners must survive repeated independent validation before inheritance or promotion.

mixture_of_experts_shadow.gating: Race structure is classified pre-seal and expert weights are changed by race pattern and each expert's independently validated reproducibility.
mixture_of_experts_shadow.disagreement_rule: Large expert disagreement raises uncertainty and may move a race to CAUTION or PASS instead of forcing a consensus.
mixture_of_experts_shadow.output_rule: The ensemble produces one shared axis/candidate core; trio, place, wide, quinella, win and trifecta derive from that common core with wager-specific conditions.
mixture_of_experts_shadow.integration_gate: No ensemble or expert can become production champion from a single block. It must pass repeated independent validation, large-sample gates and final unseen validation.
